jobs_results.title: Golang Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
A pioneer and market leader in Open Banking, Unnax is committed to supporting financial players in designing services and payment experiences that users love.

Unnax was founded in Barcelona in 2016, one of the first Open Banking platforms in Europe.

Our cutting-edge, end-to-end platform empowers leading financial services companies to access accurate financial data from multiple sources. Our products allow you to automate processes, improve risk management, make & receive payments, shorten decision-making times, and enrich customer journeys.

We are a trusted partner to the top financial industry players and software editors in Europe, and we have achieved this by scouting the best talents. Joining Unnax means being a part of an inclusive, multicultural, and international team of over 60 employees.

We are building a team that builds better banking. Apply now to take part in the future of finance!

Job Description:

As a Golan Software Engineer, you will join our Baas Squad which is... international and composed of 5 people.

Your missions:
• Produce quality code and tests, build prototypes, solve issues, profile and analyze bottlenecks
• Design perform, robust APIs to support mobile and desktop clients
• Manage and optimize scalable distributed systems on the cloud
• Optimization of backend applications for performance and scalability
• Regularly communicate with stakeholders: product managers, quality assurance, and other developers regarding progress on the long-term technology roadmap
• Recommend system solutions by comparing advantages and disadvantages of custom development and open source alternatives
• Develop automated tests to ensure business needs are met and allow for regression testing

Profile and skills required:
• Minimum 3 Years developing backend code. Experience with Software Programming Principles and Design Patterns.
• Fluent in Spanish and English (written and spoken), French will be a plus
• Proven experience in Go or one of theses languages (C, C++, C#, Kotlin or Rust)
• Experience or knowledge of these technologies: Databases (SQL, non-relational), Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD
• Growth mindset, challenging status quo to find new solutions and out-of-the-box ideas
• Experience designing RESTful APIs, experience with GRPC would be a plus
• Experience with core AWS web-enabling technologies would be a plus

Unnax is an Equal Opportunity Employer which means we pledge to not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetic information.. If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please let us know what you need and we will do our best to accommodate

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de Software .NET
jobs_results.description:
¿Eres un apasionado del desarrollo en entornos Microsoft? ¡¡¡Esto te interesa!!!

Buscamos Ingeniero de Software .NET para incorporarse a nuestra Comunidad Microsoft y participar en nuestros proyectos desde nuestros centros de desarrollo, así como nuestra de Red de talento Remoto.

Requisitos mínimos:

● 3 años de experiencia o más en desarrollo C#

● Conocimientos y/o experiencia en ASP.NET Core y ASP.NET - Especialmente MVC y WebAPI

● Conocimientos y/o experiencia en API REST, servicios web SOAP y microservicios

● Estar familiarizado con trabajar con formatos de datos como JSON y XML

● Has trabajado con bases de datos relacionales: SQL Server y PostgreSQL

● Tienes conocimientos y/o experiencia con bases de datos no relacionales NoSQL.

Requisitos deseados:

- Conocimientos de patrones de diseño, MVC, MVVC y acceso a datos.

- Experiencia en desarrollo Front y algún framework. Si no, entrarás en nuestro plan de capacitación en Angular o React.

- Experiencia en desarrollos Azure... (PaaS y SaaS)

- Experiencia en desarrollos Sharepoint

- TFS/VSTS/Azure DevOps

En knowmad mood utilizamos la tecnología para estar cerca, nos profesionalizamos, investigamos, creamos y vendemos nuestras propias creaciones, nos certificamos, realizamos eventos, nos divertimos y además ayudamos a nuestros clientes a tener mejores procesos de producción.

¿Qué más se puede pedir? Pues además puedes contar con beneficios como:

- Formación en inglés para todos desde el primer día y formación en últimas tecnologías.

- Opción de retribución flexible (tickets restaurante, cheques guardería, tarjeta transporte, seguro médico) y certificaciones oficiales.

- Buen ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de desarrollo profesional en una empresa en crecimiento, organizada por centros expertos con identidad propia.

- Club de ventajas: benefíciate de nuestros descuentos en productos y servicios.

- Embajador de nuestra marca, a través de nuestro Friends Mood.

- Eventos, meetups, techdays, charlas...Además de otros beneficios y sorpresas que vamos realizando a lo largo del año

¿A qué suena interesante? Pues, ¡ven a conocernos y juzga tú mismo

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer Oracle APEX 100% Remoto
jobs_results.description:
Desde Ibertech nos encontramos en búsqueda de personas que quieran formar parte de un gran equipo y para ello buscamos un/una Software Engineer Oracle APEX:

Requisitos:
• Preferible más de 6 años de experiencia (o al menos 3 años mínimo):
• Experiencia de más de 6 años en desarrollo de aplicaciones a medida con alguna tecnología como Java, Javascript, base de datos Oracle, PL/SQL
• Experiencia de más de 3 años utilizando la plataforma Oracle APEX para desarrollo de aplicaciones, tiene que ser un referente en el uso de esta tecnología
• Conocimientos consolidados en diseño y arquitectura en desarrollo de aplicaciones utilizando base de datos Oracle (SQL, PLSQL, etc)
• Conocimientos consolidados en diseño y arquitectura en desarrollo de aplicaciones web (Javascript, HTML, CSS)
• Capaz de abordar desarrollos nuevos, migraciones o mantenimiento

Valorable:
• Valorable experiencia en Oracle Forms y Oracle Reports
• Valorable experiencia en Scrum y Agile, uso de Atlassian... JIRA

Características:
• Contrato indefinido
• Estable
• Modelo 100% Remoto, valorable también 1 o 2 días in situ en Madrid.
• Jornada completa
• Planes formativos
• Retribución flexible

Nuestra misión es ayudar a nuestros clientes a mejorar sus capacidades y competencias adaptándonos y creando soluciones a medida, a través del conocimiento profundo y específico de las tecnologías de la información y comunicaciones de nuestro equipo, además de generar valor en los negocios de nuestros clientes, proporcionando servicios de alta calidad en las actividades que desarrollamos

jobs_results.title: PROGRAMADOR/A C - C++
jobs_results.description:
Desde Adecco, buscando un/a programador/a C y C++ enfocado a microcontroladores,para trabajar en el desarrollador de firmware para una importante empresa del sector industrial.

Responsabilidades:
• Diseñar, desarrollar y depurar firmware para microcontroladores.
• Colaborar con el equipo de ingeniería para diseñar soluciones efectivas y eficientes.
• Realizar pruebas exhaustivas para garantizar la calidad del firmware desarrollado.
• Mantenerse actualizado sobre las últimas tecnologías y tendencias en el campo de sistemas embebidos.

Requisitos:
• Título universitario en Ingeniería Electrónica, o similar.
• Experiencia demostrable en programación C y C++, valorable para microcontroladores.
• Alto interés hacia el desarrollo de firmware y sistemas embebidos.
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y en equipo.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y resolución de problemas.

Ofrecemos:
• Contrato indefinido e incorporación directa con la empresa.
• Salario a convenir en... función del perfil, franja aproximada 28 - 30K + BONUS + ticket restaurante.
• Modelo de trabajo presencial con horario flexible.
• Condiciones de retribución flexible para adaptarse a tus necesidades individuales.

Si estás buscando un entorno de trabajo dinámico y desafiante, y cumples con los requisitos mencionados, ¡esta oferta es para ti!

¡TE ESPERAMOS

jobs_results.title: C++ Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
If you want to see your future on the tracks ....... Your place is with us!

We are expanding our teams in the ITS (Intelligent Transport Systems) sector and we are looking for a C/C++ Software Developer.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

Your main duties will be to:
• Analysis, Development & Validation of backoffice software.
• Assure that the project requirements are fulfilled
• Generation of product and project documentation: functional descriptions, specification documents, etc.
• Perform an accurate control of source versions
• Perform a great validation & verification of applications/modules, according to our internal Quality System
• Definition of test-benches, unitary tests and automated test for modules, etc.
• Assure a perfect coordination with other colleagues and with the Technical Manager Maintenance of current applications and modules, issues analysis... bug fixing.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for profiles with experience in Visual C++, C# Advanced MS SQL, Oracle.

We will also value previous experience with Front-End technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery Media React/Redux Basic RESTful APIs Medium Unit Testing Basic.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Alejandra Estévez Melgarejo, in charge of this vacancy.

Alejandra Estévez Melgarejo

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer Java/J2EE H/M
jobs_results.description:
Mission

En INETUM ofrecemos la oportunidad de integrarse en una empresa especializada en Consultoría IT, para participar en proyectos innovadores, con tecnologías actualizadas y con un plan de carrera y evolución a largo plazo.

Perfil

Desde la línea de Desarrollo de Inetum Norte, estamos en búsqueda de un perfil con experiencia como Analista programador/a JAVA.

Pensamos en titulados/as técnicos, que aporten experiencia en entornos Java/J2EE para integrarse en nuestros equipos de desarrollo, en modalidad hibrida, para participar en proyectos y servicios orientados a importantes clientes del sector público.

Organización

Somos un grupo internacional de consultoría digital ágil. En la era de la post transformación digital, nos esforzamos por permitir que cada uno de nuestros 27 000 profesionales se renueve continuamente viviendo de manera positiva su propio flow digital.

Cada uno de ellos puede moldear su trayectoria profesional de acuerdo con sus preferencias, emprender de forma... práctica para construir junto a sus clientes un mundo más positivo, innovar localmente en 26 países y armonizar su carrera profesional con su bienestar personal.

Únete a Inetum. Live your positive digital flow

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer - Java
jobs_results.description:
• Before applying for this role, please note that this job must be performed in Spain. Only candidates currently residing in Spain or willing to relocate will be considered.

Are you ready to be inspired, challenged, motivated to do your best, and have fun while you're at it? We're on the lookout for a Java Software Engineer to join our team at Mimacom, where we play off each other's strengths to create exciting digital products for customers all over the world.

At Mimacom, we stay ahead of the curve. We develop digital products that enable businesses to achieve faster, easier, and more impressive results, whether it's in banking, retail, manufacturing, life sciences, or beyond. Right now, our software touches the lives of 50 million users every single day.

Behind every one of our products is a brilliant group of people who share the same values, working collaboratively to create actual solutions for real problems. Join us at Mimacom as a Java Software Engineer and let's create... something amazing together!

What You'll Do:

As part of our team, your contributions will play a part in helping today’s leading companies stay ahead. As a Java Software Engineer, you will in charge of developing quality code, mainly focusing on microservices, and always following best practices. Here's an overview of what you'll be doing:
• You will design and develop software with a strong microservices orientation.
• You will participate in the definition and refinement of user stories, as well as in the estimation and planning of tasks.
• Be part of a team that applies a continuous improvement model by doing pair programming, code reviews, etc.
• Collaborate in the communities of practice in which we do coding dojos, open spaces, testing combat, etc. in order to deepen, share and acquire knowledge about design principles, types of architecture and software development in general.
• Bring code quality and good practices.

What You'll Need:

We are seeking individuals who are team players with an analytical mindset. Beyond that, you’ll succeed in this role if you’ve got the following qualifications:
• 4+ years of experience as a Backend Engineer with a high level of proficiency in Java, Spring Boot and microservices.
• You have ability to work with tools such as Kubernetes, Jenkins, Docker...
• You are able to write efficient, secure, well-documented clean code.
• Good level in both English and Spanish.
• You are based in Spain, or are willing to relocate.

Even if you don’t check off every one of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you. Talk to one of our recruitment team to discuss what you might be able to bring to our projects.

What to Expect:

Your personal and professional growth is important to us, and we offer a range of benefits and opportunities to support your journey. Here's what you can expect when joining our team:
• Holidays & Flextime: You will enjoy 30 days of vacation. We understand that while you love your work, it’s just one part of a whole person. That’s why we allow you to work in a way that accommodates your lifestyle and other commitments.
• Fully Remote from anywhere in Spain: No matter where you are, be part of the team. Beat the commute and join us from the comfort of your own home with this remote position. Or, if you wish, come to any of our offices in Madrid, Valencia, Barcelona or Gijón.
• Career Growth: We work hand-in-hand with you to create a plan that fuels your professional development and helps you make an impact on your projects.
• Hardware Budget: We offer your choice of hardware packages, providing you with the tools you need to do your best work.
• Team Get-Togethers: From sharing a meal to team retreats, we invest in the things that make you feel part of a community. You don’t have to come, but it'd be great to have you there.

At Mimacom, we know that creative minds thrive on exciting projects. Join our team and be part of a lively community that’s all about working together, growing together, and coming up with innovative ideas and technologies!

Our company is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all walks of life to apply, as we believe in providing equal opportunities to everyone

• Team Get-Togethers: From sharing a meal to team retreats, we invest in the things that make you feel part of a community. You don’t have to come, but it'd be great to have you there.

At Mimacom, we know that creative minds thrive on exciting projects. Join our team and be part of a lively community that’s all about working together, growing together, and coming up with innovative ideas and technologies!

Our company is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all walks of life to apply, as we believe in providing equal opportunities to everyone

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de Software entorno Cloud (Teletrabajo en España) - España
jobs_results.description:
Desde Sandav estamos buscando un Ingeniero/a de Software con experiencia en tecnologías Cloud para incorporarse al área de Inteligencia de Red de uno de nuestros clientes

Podrás ampliar tu perfil profesional trabajando en el desarrollo de aplicaciones con lenguajes como Python y bases de datos (como SQL, Elastic), pero también participando en el despliegue en contenedores con Docker en entornos cloud (Amazon, Google Cloud, Azure).

Se Requiere
• Licenciado en Telecomunicaciones/Ingeniero de Software o carreras técnicas afines.
• +3 años de experiencia en Desarrollo de Software programando en Python y bases de datos (SQL, ELasticSearch, MariaDB...) además de experiencia en construcción e integración de aplicaciones basadas en microservicios con herramientas como Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, Linux, entornos cloud (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure), scripting, etc
• Experiencia en prácticas de CI/CD
• Nivel B2 o superior de inglés (hablado y escrito).

Se Ofrece
• Puesto estable y contrato... indefinido.
• Formato Híbrido en Madrid (2-4 días de oficina al mes)
• Horario: flexible en cuanto a entrada y salida. Jornada intensiva viernes y en agosto.
• Salario en función de experiencia y conocimientos. Abierto a negociación
• Retribución flexible: con tarjetas de restaurante, guardería y transporte para que aproveches al máximo tu salario.

SANDAV es una empresa que basa la relación con sus empleados en la INTEGRIDAD, que en resumen quiere decir que CUMPLIMOS LO PROMETIDO

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador GitHub.com/ DevOps
jobs_results.description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Optimissa es una empresa de consultoría especializada en Financial Services, siempre en búsqueda permanente de los mayores entusiastas de la Consultoría.

En esta ocasión queremos incorporar un Desarrollador GitHub/ DevOps para uno de nuestros mas importantes clientes en el sector bancario. Las funciones serán:
• Creación de acciones y workflows en GitHub.com (necesarios conocimientos de desarrollo con yaml y typescript) y Github apps
• Integración entre las diferentes herramientas que forman parte de la plataforma: Github.com, Nexus, Harbor, SonarQube, Fortify, Kubernates.
• Conocimiento de los diferentes modelos de control de versiones o flujo de trabajo: GitFlow, Trunk, GitOps.

Requisitos:
• Perfil DevOps
• Experiencia con lenguajes de programación: yaml, Typescript, Shellscript
• Experiencia con: GitHub.com (acciones, workflows, etc) y Github apps
• Experiencia en Kubernetes, Docker, Helm.
• Modelos de control de versiones: GitFlow, Trunk, GitOps
• Experiencia... trabajando con metodologías ágiles

Ofrecemos:

-Incorporación estable

-Excelente ambiente de trabajo

-Plan de carrera profesional

-Salario negociable según experiencia

-Plan de Retribución Flexible: combinación de salario base + beneficios que se adaptan a tus circunstancias (Ticket restaurant, seguro médico, cheque guardería, ticket transporte)

-Jornada flexible y formato remoto

-Zona de trabajo: 100% remoto

jobs_results.title: Ruby Software Engineer II
jobs_results.description:
✅WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:
• 2+ years of experience developing and supporting critical business applications
• Excellent communicator and collaborator
• Experience building web applications and REST APIs with Ruby/Ruby on Rails
• Extensive experience with at least one modern frontend JavaScript framework (Vue preferred)
• Demonstrated experience with Git and release/branching strategies
• Experience with code reviews and able to provide feedback and guidance to colleagues
• Proficient in English (C1 or higher)

✅PRIMEREVENUE PERKS:
• 🌎Generous benefits and time off programs
• 🚀Professional growth, learning, and development opportunities
• 🧠Innovative, global, TEAM centric environment
• ✨ Competitive pay, bonus, and retirement programs
• 🏡Collaborative, casual, fun, and flexible work environment with access to top technology, stocked breakrooms, and coffee bars
• 🎉TEAM events and employee celebrations

✅A DAY IN THE LIFE:
• Develop new features and product improvements using... Ruby, Rails, and Vue.js
• Participate in the building of product through the entire software development lifecycle – research, planning, development, deployment, and support
• Understand modern and legacy application architectures to support our application, fix defects, and add required features
• Participate in product deployments and ongoing support rotation
• Participate in, and reinforce, our agile development practice
• Participate in our engineer hiring process
• Actively work to make our products better through:

-Research and implementation of software development best practices

-Architectural design and planning sessions

-TDD (Test Driven Development) and code reviews

-Identification and documentation of product improvement areas

✅ARE YOU READY TO WORK AT PRIMEREVENUE?

PrimeRevenue is a global FinTech based in Atlanta, GA. We've been serving Fortune 500 companies and their suppliers since 2003, and we're growing faster than ever.

WHO ARE YOU?

SMART, HUNGRY, & HUMBLE PERSONALITY IS A MUST! 💯

Our values are built upon what we call PRIDE + Integrity –
• Performance, Respect, Innovation, Diversity, Excellence and, above all, Integrity. At PrimeRevenue, you will work with a great global TEAM that is pursuing a massive overall opportunity
